item.title: McQuiston: Why Winter Fender-Benders Cost More Than Summer Ones
item.description: By ALLEN MCQUISTON Jemez Insurance Agency Serving Los Alamos Since 1963 A winter fender-bender often looks harmless. Low speeds, light damage, everyone drives away. But many drivers are surprised to learn that those same minor accidents usually cost more to fix in winter than in summer. Here’s why. item.title: New Mexico House Republicans Unveil Tax Plan To Protect Paychecks, Support Families, And Help Seniors Keep More Of What They Earn
item.description: From New Mexico House Republican: SANTA FE — House Republicans are rolling out a comprehensive Tax Relief Plan focused on one simple goal: letting New Mexicans keep more of their own money. Families across our state are working harder, paying more, and getting less in return. Our tax plan takes a different approach.
